cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Offline AI tutor for schools in low-connectivity environments, combining local curriculum materials with structured learning and interactive explanations.

test_prompts.prompt: A student connects a thin, long wire in a circuit and notices the bulb is dimmer than when using a short, thick wire. Explain why this happens at a lower secondary level.
What is (48 / 6) + 7 * 2? Then explain in one simple sentence what order of operations means.
